_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Owe udi Mwana {player_id} mu ndamba ya LinesOfAction.
Bikunda byobe ni '{side}', bikunda bya mukonda ni '{other}'.
Mfumo wa kusonga: `[b1b3]` (kuva-kwenda). Songa ya kikatengo kikendeke kwa mpimo wa kisonga, kwa kisonga, kwa mpimo wa kisonga, kwa kusonga munda wa bikunda byonso (wa mutengo wowote) mu kisonga kile. Owe usonga kupita bikunda byobe, kansi si bikunda bya mukonda; kusonga kwa mukonda kikukwata.  Owe ushinda loko bikunda byobe byonso bikatengele.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tshikebelu tshidi ne bua kuikala e2e4 (ku, too ne ku) muinshi mua bikadilu.
invalid_move.no_piece: Kakuena mukanda {side} mu tshibejibeji tshia {coord} to.
invalid_move.identical: Tshia kufila ne tshia kuya nabi bidi bifuanangane.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Udi ne bua kuya buludiludi anyi mu diagon.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Udi ne bua kuya mutantshi mule mu mulongo umue.
invalid_move.destination_own: Kifula kya kwenda kikuti kibwata na kibindi kyetu.

game_action.captured_suffix: Mwadi {player_id} akwisa {from} -> {to} akwisha muntu wa musangidi.
